entries.title: Adding a Claude account on Windows no longer stops at a login it can't read
entries.body: When Claude Code had signed out or its login had lapsed on a Windows PC, adding a Claude account could refuse every time, saying Infinitary couldn't read the Claude login. It now goes on to Claude's own sign-in. If the login really can't be read, the advice now points to the Start menu instead of the Dock.
entries.noPicture: The change is in how the login file is read during an account add; the window looks the same except on a Windows PC where the add now reaches Claude's sign-in.
